get.summary: Read saved admission and the current operation observation
get.description: Session only; no query including an empty query. Runtime fields share one Reader observation and are jointly null when stopped, unavailable or inconsistent with saved policy. active_operations counts managed authorization leases, not sockets or flushed buffers. Zero does not permit a forced stop. Continue using normal protocol-driven graceful shutdown. No probe, polling, mutation or wait-for-drain is started.

200.description: Saved facts and optional current runtime observation.

503.description: management_upgrade_required or policy_unavailable; no healthy default.

post.summary: Pause or resume admission for new managed proxy operations
post.description: Session and CSRF only; schema19 required; no query. Administrator, expected node identity, local ownership epoch and policy CAS are rechecked in the commit transaction. Existing operations retain their leases; ordinary run listeners and management API availability are unchanged. Durable commit precedes complete Reader publication. After an explicit runtime quiesce, accepting=true is refused with proxy_restart_required; it cannot recreate stopped listeners. Response loss is an unknown write: do not automatically resubmit. A new status observation describes current facts, not proof that this request caused them. No force-stop, flush, restart or migration. Automation users:write does not grant maintenance authority.

200.description: Publication receipt; running was sampled at publication, not a new count observation.

get.summary: Read the selected target's maintenance facts
get.description: Session only; no query. Fixed node v5 over configured mTLS, current exact-DER peer/owner authorization and bounded budgets. Validate node, version, decimals and runtime relationships; retain target epoch/command/policy rollback floors. Older unsupported nodes fail explicitly, without falling back to local or target-delivery state. One observation, not a remote drain or probe.

post.summary: Read the original retained maintenance receipt
post.description: Session and CSRF only; no query. The body binds the original job_id. A replaced slot or non-maintenance intent is refused before any receipt request. The selected target's current mTLS/owner authorization and original version5 receipt identity remain mandatory. This never resends a command, rotates a secret, waits for operations or proves transport drain.

200.description: The same typed maintenance ticket with its observed receipt; no secrets.

post.summary: Submit one admission intent to the durable peer queue
post.description: Session and CSRF only; no query. Version5 uses existing owner epoch, shared command order and policy CAS, distinct from pausing target delivery. Background delivery may retry the same retained command identity. Cancellation or 202 never authorizes a new command: inspect the original job/receipt or explicitly supersede. Saved/Applied mean durable acceptance/historical publication, not operation completion, flushed buffers or safe forced shutdown. No credential or secret is generated.

200.description: Original ticket and validated first receipt; may be rejected or not yet applied.

202.description: Original durable ticket with response=null; first delivery unknown.

MaintenanceIntent.description: Non-secret desired admission derived from the retained typed v5 intent, including unresolved/rejected jobs. Not live state or an applied receipt.

MaintenanceStatus.description: Nullable keys are required. Durable applied<=saved. Known runtime requires running, applied=saved, runtime_accepting=saved_accepting. Otherwise all three runtime fields are null. No drained/force-stop safety conclusion.

MaintenanceChange.description: applied=saved exactly when running at publication; no operation count or live drain claim.
